title: Hãy gọi tài xế này cho tôi
englishTitle: Please call this driver for me
pronunciation: Hay goi tai xe nay cho toi
summary: For asking someone to call the driver shown on your booking or pickup screen.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it when the driver is hard to find, messages are not working, or the pickup point is confusing.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the phone number or booking screen first so the helper knows exactly who to call.

phrases.vietnamese: Hãy gọi tài xế này cho tôi
phrases.english: Please call this driver for me
phrases.pronunciation: Hay goi tai xe nay cho toi

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Hãy gọi means please call; tài xế này means this driver; cho tôi means for me.

breakdown.vietnamese: Hãy gọi tài xế này cho tôi
breakdown.english: Please call this driver for me

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Driver canceled, contact the driver, and Grab pickup phrases help if the call becomes a ride problem.

phrases.english: Where is the Grab pickup point?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at airport pickup points, hotel desks, tour counters, security desks, and ride-hailing help spots.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Keep the phone unlocked and the number visible. If the driver cancels, switch to the driver canceled phrase.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Pickup area, driver meetup, missing bag, domestic terminal, and visa phrases cover arrival follow-ups.
